content.thinking: Oops, my edit broke the exception handling — `verify.Bad` is no longer caught. Let me rewrite the check function properly.

arguments.command:
cd /workspace/tmp && python3 - <<'EOF'
p='runverify.py'
s=open(p).read()
old = s[s.index('def check(inst_raw):'):s.index('def main():')]
new = '''def check(inst_raw):
    try:
        inst = parse_request(json.loads(json.dumps(inst_raw)))
    except Invalid:
        return True, 0.0
    t0 = time.time(); resp = solve(inst); el = time.time() - t0
    t1 = time.time()
    try:
        verify.verify(inst, resp)
        bad = None
    except verify.Bad as e:
        bad = e
    vt = time.time() - t1
    print('   %s status=%s solve=%.2fs verify=%.2fs' %
          (inst['id'], resp.get('status'), el, vt), flush=True)
    if bad is not None:
        print('VERIFY FAIL', inst['id'], bad)
        print(json.dumps(inst)[:1500])
        print(json.dumps(resp)[:1500])
        return False, el
    return True, el


'''
s = s.replace(old, new)
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
